name: Limitless Anime Baseline
description: Frozen anime-first Nuvio provider baseline maintained directly in Limitless-Nuviostream.

scrapers.name: 123Anime
scrapers.description: Limitless AniYomi-to-Nuvio port of 123Anime with season-aware MAL mapping, exact aliases, compact subtitle tags, mirror failover, and JW/Legacy/SBv2 fallback routes collapsed when they resolve to the same final stream.
scrapers.author: Limitless port based on AniYomi 123Anime (Apache-2.0)

scrapers.name: AllAnime
scrapers.description: Limitless-maintained AllAnime/MKissa provider. Disabled by default because MKissa rotates its client crypto frequently; retained for future repair/testing.
scrapers.author: Limitless maintained port based on current AllAnime/MKissa protocol

scrapers.name: All-Wish
scrapers.description: Limitless-maintained All-Wish anime provider with season-aware MAL episode mapping, finite MAL/AniList/Kitsu/TMDB aliases, and standardized DUB/HARDSUB/SOFTSUB behavior tags.
scrapers.author: Limitless maintained port based on All-Wish native extraction behavior

scrapers.name: AniDB
scrapers.description: Limitless-maintained AniDB based on Eclipsia Praxiel runtime access, with exact S2+ season discovery across styled titles, MAL fallback, and standardized DUB/HARDSUB labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless maintained port based on Eclipsia Praxiel (GPL-3.0)

scrapers.name: AniNeko
scrapers.description: AniNeko multi-server streaming with standardized HARDSUB/SOFTSUB/DUB behavior tags.
scrapers.author: raymondnoodles

scrapers.name: AnikotoTV
scrapers.description: AnikotoTV with standardized DUB/SOFTSUB/DUB+SUBS output labels based on the provider's existing selectable caption tracks.
scrapers.author: piratezoro9

scrapers.name: AnimeKai
scrapers.description: Limitless-maintained AnimeKai with compact DUB/HARDSUB/SOFTSUB tags and selectable subtitle tracks exposed separately when present.

scrapers.name: AnimePahe
